# MMDAI

> Free real estate calculators for property buyers and investors across the UK, US, Poland, Germany, France, Spain, Italy and Switzerland. No signup. No paywall. 24 calculators across 7 markets in 5 languages.

MMDAI (Me, Myself and AI) provides free browser-based financial calculators built with genuine local tax depth. Every calculator uses actual legislative sources — HMRC, GNotKG, Code Général des Impôts, Ustawa o PIT, HUD guidelines. Results are estimates for informed decision-making, not substitutes for professional advice. Built by an independent investor with 15+ years of experience across project management, operations and property investment. Maintained and updated when underlying tax law changes.

## About

- [About MMDAI](https://mmandai.github.io/about/): Background, methodology, principles, market coverage and the role of AI in building the platform.

## Calculators — United Kingdom

All UK calculators apply to England and Northern Ireland. Scotland uses LBTT; Wales uses LTT.

- [UK BTL Rental Yield Calculator](https://mmandai.github.io/uk-rental-yield/): Gross yield, net yield, monthly cashflow, cash-on-cash ROI, Section 24 mortgage interest restriction impact, ICR lender stress test (PRA SS13/16). Updated for 2026 SDLT rates including October 2024 BTL surcharge.
- [UK Stamp Duty (SDLT) Calculator](https://mmandai.github.io/uk-sdlt-calculator/): Full banded SDLT calculation for first-time buyers, home movers and buy-to-let investors. Includes October 2024 5% BTL surcharge, April 2025 nil-rate reversion to £125k, non-UK resident 2% surcharge, and pre-April 2025 comparison.
- [UK Flip Profit Calculator](https://mmandai.github.io/uk-flip-and-profit/): Purchase costs, refurbishment, holding costs, sale fees, CGT vs Income Tax comparison for property flips.
- [UK HMO Yield Calculator](https://mmandai.github.io/uk-hmo-calculator/): House in Multiple Occupation yield, room-by-room income, mandatory and additional HMO licensing costs, net ROI.
- [UK Section 24 / Ltd Co Calculator](https://mmandai.github.io/uk-section24/): Personal ownership vs limited company comparison after Section 24 mortgage interest restriction (Finance Act 2015). Models exact tax difference by income tax band.
- [UK Rent vs Buy Calculator](https://mmandai.github.io/uk-rent-vs-buy/): 10-year comparison of renting vs buying — equity built, deposit opportunity cost, SDLT drag, break-even year, year-by-year projection.

## Calculators — United States

- [US Mortgage Affordability Calculator](https://mmandai.github.io/us-mortgage-affordability/): DTI ratio (front-end and back-end), monthly PITI breakdown, PMI, FHA MIP, VA funding fee, max home price, stress test. Conventional, FHA and VA loans compared.
- [US Rental Property ROI Calculator](https://mmandai.github.io/us-rental-roi/): Cap rate, cash-on-cash ROI, MACRS depreciation schedule, Schedule E tax estimate, 1% rule check.
- [US Closing Costs Calculator](https://mmandai.github.io/us-closing-cost-estimator/): Buyer and seller closing costs for all 50 states — transfer taxes, title insurance, attorney fees, lender charges.
- [US Calculadora de Hipoteca](https://mmandai.github.io/us-hipoteca/): Versión en español — DTI, pago mensual PITI, PMI y precio máximo de vivienda. Convencional, FHA y VA comparados.
- [US ROI Propiedad de Alquiler](https://mmandai.github.io/us-roi-alquiler/): Versión en español — tasa de capitalización, rendimiento cash-on-cash, depreciación MACRS, Schedule E y regla del 1%.
- [US Alquilar o Comprar](https://mmandai.github.io/us-alquilar-comprar/): Versión en español — comparación financiera completa a 10 años, patrimonio acumulado, costo de oportunidad y punto de equilibrio.

## Calculators — Poland

- [Kredyt vs Wynajem](https://mmandai.github.io/pl-kredyt-vs-wynajem/): Kredyt hipoteczny czy wynajem — wskaźnik cena/czynsz, tabela 10-letnia, 3 scenariusze oprocentowania WIBOR.
- [Rentowność Najmu](https://mmandai.github.io/pl-rentownosc-najmu/): ROI netto z wynajmu, zysk miesięczny, podatek ryczałtowy 8,5% (Ustawa o PIT art. 6 ust. 1a), pustostany, projekcja 5-letnia, 3 scenariusze.
- [Pakiet Inwestora](https://mmandai.github.io/pakiet-inwestora/): Porównywarka nieruchomości (do 3 ofert), kalkulator zysku z flipu z holding costs, estymator kosztów remontu z cenami rynkowymi 2026 w 4 poziomach wykończenia.

## Calculators — Germany

- [Grunderwerbsteuer Rechner](https://mmandai.github.io/de-grunderwerbsteuer/): Grunderwerbsteuer dla wszystkich 16 Bundesländer (3,5%–6,5%), Notargebühren nach GNotKG, Grundbucheintrag, Maklerprovision nach Bestellerprinzip, monatliche Kreditrate.
- [Immobilien Renditerechner](https://mmandai.github.io/de-renditerechner/): Nettomietrendite, AfA nach Baujahr, Cashflow nach Steuer, Kaufpreisfaktor, Eigenkapitalrendite.
- [AfA-Rechner](https://mmandai.github.io/de-afa/): Lineare AfA, degressive AfA und §7b Sonder-AfA. Steuerersparnis und 50-jähriger Abschreibungsplan.

## Calculators — France

- [Rendement Locatif LMNP vs Nue](https://mmandai.github.io/fr-rendement-locatif/): Comparaison des 6 régimes fiscaux — Micro-Foncier, Réel Foncier, Micro-BIC, LMNP Réel, SCI IR, SCI IS. Cashflow net après impôts, impact LF 2025 (loi n°2025-127 du 14 février 2025) sur la plus-value LMNP à la revente.
- [Plus-Value Immobilière](https://mmandai.github.io/fr-plus-value-immobiliere/): IR 19%, prélèvements sociaux 17,2%, abattements par durée de détention, surtaxe progressive, impact LF 2025 pour LMNP réel.

## Calculators — Switzerland

Available in both German and French.

- [Amortissement Direct vs Indirect (FR)](https://mmandai.github.io/ch-fr-amortissement-direct-vs-indirect/): Pilier 3a, économie fiscale, avantage net, impact suppression valeur locative 2028.
- [Direkte vs. Indirekte Amortisation (DE)](https://mmandai.github.io/ch-de-direkte-vs-indirekte-rechner/): Säule 3a, Steuerersparnis, Kapitalvergleich, Eigenmietwert-Abschaffung 2028.

## Calculators — Spain

- [Calculadora ITP y Gastos de Compraventa](https://mmandai.github.io/es-itp/): ITP, AJD, notaría, registro y gestoría para las 19 Comunidades Autónomas. Segunda mano y obra nueva.

## Calculators — Italy

- [Cedolare Secca vs IRPEF](https://mmandai.github.io/it-cedolare-secca-vs-irpef/): Confronto dei due regimi fiscali — canone libero (21%), concordato (10%), affitti brevi (26%). Scaglioni IRPEF 2026, addizionali regionali e comunali, imposta di registro.

## Glossaries

Each market has a dedicated glossary with definitions, formulas, worked examples and cross-links to relevant calculators.

- [UK Property Glossary](https://mmandai.github.io/uk-glossary/): SDLT, Section 24, ICR, LTV, BTL yield, HMO, CGT, leasehold, freehold, EPC and more.
- [US Real Estate Glossary](https://mmandai.github.io/us-glossary/): DTI, PMI, MIP, cap rate, MACRS, Schedule E, escrow, closing costs and more.
- [US Glosario Inmobiliario](https://mmandai.github.io/us-glosario/): Versión en español — DTI, PMI, tasa de capitalización, depreciación MACRS y más.
- [Słownik Inwestora PL](https://mmandai.github.io/pl-slownik/): ROI, rentowność najmu, ryczałt, PCC, flip, LTV, WIBOR, zdolność kredytowa i więcej.
- [Immobilien Glossar DE](https://mmandai.github.io/de-glossar/): Grunderwerbsteuer, AfA, Nettomietrendite, Kaufpreisfaktor, Bestellerprinzip i więcej.
- [Glossaire Immobilier FR](https://mmandai.github.io/fr-glossaire/): LMNP, micro-BIC, réel foncier, plus-value, SCI, déficit foncier et plus.
- [Glossar Schweiz DE](https://mmandai.github.io/ch-glossar/): Amortisation, Säule 3a, Eigenmietwert, Tragbarkeit, Belehnung und mehr.
- [Glossaire Suisse FR](https://mmandai.github.io/ch-glossaire/): Amortissement, pilier 3a, valeur locative, capacité financière et plus.
- [Glosario Inmobiliario ES](https://mmandai.github.io/es-glosario/): ITP, AJD, plusvalía municipal, nota simple, gastos de hipoteca y más.
- [Glossario Immobiliare IT](https://mmandai.github.io/it-glossario/): Cedolare secca, IRPEF, rogito, visura catastale, mutuo e più.

## Methodology

Every calculator includes an inline methodology section with the exact formulas used and references to legislative sources. Key sources include: HMRC SDLT guidance · Finance Act 2015 §24 · PRA SS13/16 · GNotKG · Corporation Tax Act 2010 · Code Général des Impôts · Loi de Finances 2025 (n°2025-127) · Ustawa o PIT · HUD/FHA guidelines · IRS Publication 946 (MACRS).

## Usage

All web calculators are free to use without signup or registration. Content may be referenced and cited freely for informational purposes. Results are estimates — not financial, tax or legal advice. Always consult a qualified professional before making property decisions.
